# Vendored skill — attribution

- **Skill:** `review-animations` (with `STANDARDS.md`)
- **Upstream:** https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills (`skills/review-animations/`)
- **Author:** Emil Kowalski
- **License:** MIT (see `LICENSE.upstream`)

This is an unmodified vendored copy, included so the skill library is self-contained
and installable offline. To pull upstream updates, re-copy `SKILL.md` + `STANDARDS.md`
from the source repo. The upstream also distributes via `npx skills add emilkowalski/skills`.
